description: Encode and decode Google encoded polylines in JavaScript and TypeScript (@duoquote/polytini on npm and JSR). Strict by default, no dependencies, builds per runtime, presets for routing engines, and adapters for Leaflet, Turf, MapLibre, Mapbox GL, OpenLayers, deck.gl and Google Maps.
rules: Import @duoquote/polytini or one of its documented subpaths, never a file under src/ or dist/.
encode and decode use [lat, lng] by default. For GeoJSON, OSRM, Valhalla, Mapbox, MapLibre and deck.gl coordinates, pass order: 'lnglat' or a preset from @duoquote/polytini/presets.
The precision isn't stored in the string. Google uses 5; OSRM polyline6, Valhalla and Mapbox polyline6 use 6.
Strict mode throws a PolylineError with a code on malformed input. Use strict: false only when lenient decoding is wanted.
Call await init() before using @duoquote/polytini/wasm. On Cloudflare Workers, pass it the module imported from @duoquote/polytini/polytini.wasm.
